# European Network Against Racism (ENAR)

> Pan-European anti-racism network advocating for racial equality, combating structural racism, and advancing policy reforms across the EU.

ENAR is a Brussels-based advocacy organization that works across EU Member States to address systemic racial discrimination, hate crimes, ethnic profiling, and intersectional inequalities. The network combines research, policy advocacy, and grassroots mobilization to promote racial justice and equality in Europe.

## Key Topics

- Structural racism
- Racial equality
- Anti-racism advocacy
- EU policy
- Ethnic profiling
- Racist crime
- Equality data
- Racial justice
- Ethnic minorities
- Security and policing
- Employment discrimination
- Climate justice
- Human rights
- Migrants
- Roma rights

## Core Resources & Advocacy Areas

- [Home](https://www.enar-eu.org): ENAR homepage: pan-European anti-racism network for racial equality advocacy
- [About](https://www.enar-eu.org/about): ENAR mission and vision to end structural racism and discrimination in Europe
- [Structural Racism](https://www.enar-eu.org/structural-racism): ENAR resource page on structural racism, systemic discrimination, and advocacy
- [Equality Data](https://www.enar-eu.org/equality-data): ENAR resource on equality data collection, discrimination measurement, and hate crime
- [Action Plans Against Racism](https://www.enar-eu.org/action-plans-against-racism): ENAR page on action plans and national frameworks for combating racism in EU

## Policy & Legal Frameworks

- [Racist Crime](https://www.enar-eu.org/racist-crime): ENAR page on racist and hate crime legislation, enforcement, and victim support
- [Security & Policing](https://www.enar-eu.org/security-policing): ENAR resource on ethnic profiling, counter-terrorism, and police discrimination
- [Employment](https://www.enar-eu.org/employment): ENAR page on employment discrimination, workplace equality, and Equal@work Platform
- [Climate Justice](https://www.enar-eu.org/climate-justice): ENAR resource on climate justice and environmental racism affecting communities

## Research & Publications

- [Racial Profiling Practices at EU Internal Borders](https://www.enar-eu.org/booklet-racial-profiling-practices-at-eu-internal-borders): ENAR-PICUM booklet on racial profiling at EU borders and police discrimination
- [The EU's Deportation Regulation is Today's Jim Crow](https://www.enar-eu.org/the-eu-deportation-regulation-are-todays-jim-crow-laws): ENAR analysis comparing EU deportation regulation to Jim Crow laws and racism
- [The new EU Gender Equality Strategy 2026-2030: Empty Promises](https://www.enar-eu.org/the-new-eu-gender-equality-strategy-2026-2030-empty-promises-leaving-the-most-marginalised-at-the-margins): ENAR critique of EU Gender Equality Strategy 2026-2030 on intersectionality gaps

## News & Campaign Updates

- [News & Blog](https://www.enar-eu.org/news): ENAR news and blog on anti-racism, equality, and minority rights across Europe
- [We need YOU: Defund Racism. Defend Anti-Racism.](https://www.enar-eu.org/we-need-you-defund-racism-defend-anti-racism): ENAR fundraising campaign and emergency appeal for anti-racism grassroots work
